reviewed_by: Claude (unknown-id-404 bug loop); selection reviewed against the diff by the implementing agent, root cause independently validated by a separate subagent
reason: A project read whose references match nothing (unknown or deleted run, execution, handoff, tool call, /projects/{unknown}/...) resolves to the host-work owner, which never has an execution worker, yet RuntimeRouting.upstream_for answered ProjectRuntimeUnavailable 'starting', so viewers retried forever. upstream_for now raises UnownedProjectRequest (runtime_ipc.py) for an unowned host-work request and the API worker maps it to 404 code not_found (api_worker.py). project_for and host-work writes are unchanged. Python: routing (new unknown-ID regression; existing host-work and project-state tests) and API worker (new 404 mapping next to the 503 mapping tests).
exclusions: Both files also pass their PostgreSQL variants locally (79 passed with NEBULA_TEST_POSTGRES_URL). No UI change: the client already treats a non-503 error as a failed read rather than a project-runtime wait. No settings, catalog, product knowledge or native change. Revalidated on the staging Core: a sweep of 185 GET routes has no 5xx left except the long-lived /work/events stream, unknown IDs answer 404 and real chat and project reads answer 200.
